origin: cwe/476/cpp Key Principles: weak_ptr::lock() returns an empty shared_ptr when the object is gone and must be tested

finding.name: NULL Pointer Dereference
finding.summary: The notifier locks a weak_ptr and dereferences the returned shared_ptr without checking whether the observed connection still exists.

trap: Changing weak_ptr to a raw pointer, checking connection_ before lock(), or replacing weak_ptr with shared_ptr without considering lifetime ownership. The fix must test the shared_ptr returned by lock() at the point of use and define what happens after expiration.
must_preserve: Live connections still receive the message exactly once, expired connections are skipped or reported without crashing, and Notifier remains an observer rather than unnecessarily extending every connection lifetime.
